name: Sliding Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand with the ball of one foot on a folded towel and most of your weight over the other foot.
Brace your core, keep your chest upright, and slide your back foot smoothly straight backward along the floor while bending your front knee.
Lower until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your back knee hovers just above the ground.
Drive forcefully through your front heel and midfoot to glide your back foot forward to standing, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep almost all of your body weight over your front standing leg rather than leaning backward onto the sliding foot.
Track your front knee straight over your toes throughout both sliding back and pulling forward.
